summary: Transaction 3463379 for $48.92 on card C09975-K1 was flagged by monitoring because it utilized device D004630 from ring 57672119. Graph analysis revealed that device D004630 operated behind an anonymous proxy and is tied to four confirmed fraud closed cases, as well as concurrent use across four other cards between November 14 and November 16, 2016. While the low purchase amount yielded a low automated model score of 0.004, the cross-card links strongly suggest coordinated ring activity fitting Policy R9. Because the cardholder has not yet reported the transaction, the card compromise remains uncertain at a calculated probability of 0.192. A case was created, connected cards were placed on monitoring, and the file was escalated to an analyst to determine reporting actions.
